== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：北の峠</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">自分のＡＴ－ＡＴはここに移動する際フォースを消費しない。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. The printed game-text box is blank. Dark Side. Your AT-ATs do not spend Force when moving here.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed title is 北の峠, with 第４マーカー as a separate marker label. Dark says AT-ATs spend no Force moving here where English says they move here for free. Light box is blank on both faces. One Dark Force icon, no Light Force icons.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-hothnorthridge.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) (Dark)]].</ref>
